text:
No country has a majority of people who love golf, so the question's premise doesn't hold. Scotland is still the best answer, since golf originated there and it has more courses per capita than almost any country. The team note's claim that a clear majority of Scots play golf regularly doesn't match what I know of Scottish participation data, which I recall at roughly one adult in ten, so please check it against sportscotland's current figures before relying on it.

CONFIDENCE: 60
